bin.headline: This Monday, 3 August — recycling and garden waste.

events.title: Paint and Pud: Summer of Love — Bishampton
events.body: A relaxed evening of guided painting and indulgent desserts on a 'Summer of Love' theme at The Vale Golf Club, Bishampton, from 6.30pm.

events.title: Broadway Arts Festival Exhibition — Broadway
events.body: The festival's annual open art competition and exhibition runs from 25 September to 4 October, showing work by professional and amateur artists across every medium.

events.title: Evesham Rambling Club Sunday walk — Evesham
events.body: A friendly 10-mile Sunday ramble through the villages and along the River Avon, pausing for a picnic lunch; from 10am.

events.title: Fleecey Folk: Miguel Girão — Bretforton
events.body: Glasgow-based Portuguese musician Miguel Girão brings his exploration of folk traditions to the Fleece Inn, Bretforton, from 8pm.

events.title: Pershore Broad Street Market — Pershore
events.body: Around 30 stalls of farm-fresh produce, food and crafts — everything grown or made within 10 miles of the town — fill Broad Street from 9am to 2pm.

events.title: Krapp's Last Tape — David Westhead
events.body: Acclaimed actor David Westhead performs Samuel Beckett's one-man classic, followed by a Q&A, from 7pm.

events.title: Harvest Lunch — Church Lench Village Hall
events.body: Church Lench Village Hall hosts a two-course Harvest Lunch with a licensed bar and raffle, 12.15 for a 12.30 sit-down; £15 per person. Tickets from Lyndall (871925), Celia (870147) or Nadine (woakesn@hotmail.com).

events.title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang — Evesham
events.body: Phoenix Theatre Group stage the family musical based on Ian Fleming's story at The Henrician, Evesham, with evening performances from 7 to 10 October.

events.title: Apple & Ale — Bretforton
events.body: The Fleece Inn's annual cider-making weekend and real ale festival returns to the Bretforton orchard, with music, morris and merry-making from Friday 9 October.

events.title: Fleecey Folk: Breabach — Bretforton
events.body: Award-winning Scottish folk band Breabach bring their acclaimed live show to the Fleece Inn, Bretforton, from 8pm.

events.title: An Evening with Mike Tindall — Bishampton
events.body: Former England rugby World Cup winner Mike Tindall shares behind-the-scenes stories from elite sport at The Vale Golf Club, Bishampton, from 6.30pm.

eventsFootnote: Weekly regulars: yoga at Abbots Morton Village Hall on Mondays (9.45am), Lenches Tennis Club cardio on Tuesdays (6.30pm), tai chi at Abbots Morton on Wednesdays (10am), and candlelight yoga at Rous Lench Village Hall on Thursdays (6.30pm). Sunday services continue across the ARCH benefice churches at Harvington, Rous Lench, Abbots Morton, Church Lench and Norton & Lenchwick.

news.title: Tougher penalties for fly-tipping proposed
news.body: Wychavon District Council is set to consider much tougher penalties for fly-tippers, with the maximum fixed penalty rising from £1,000 to £5,000 — welcome news across the rural lanes of the Lenches, where dumped waste is a recurring problem.

news.title: Cricket club: new players welcome
news.body: With the season just ended, the club is already looking ahead — players of all ages and abilities are wanted, whether experienced, returning or brand new. Contact Venky on 07442 772470 or Charlie on 07775 660065.

notices.title: Road closures at Church Lench
notices.body: Atch Lench Road and Low Road, Church Lench, are closed until 16 October for National Grid works, with diversions in place — allow extra time when travelling locally.

notices.title: Severn Trent update — South Lenches
notices.body: South Lenches Parish Council reports the persistent Evesham Road and Hipton Hill leaks are down to the old water main, which Severn Trent must decommission before the flow can stop; timing is still to be confirmed. Further planned works follow at Hill Furze Road, Sheriffs Lench (13–26 October) and Handgate Lane (27 October–29 November).

notices.title: Autumn tennis lessons for all ages
notices.body: The Tennis Club, with new partner Encompass Coaching, is running tennis lessons for children and adults this autumn — a good chance to brush up your game or start a new one.

notices.title: Newsletter deadline
notices.body: Got something for next week? Send it to website@thelenches.org.uk by the end of Wednesday.
